title: Add post-commit hook to export beads database
description: Add git post-commit hook to automatically export beads database to beads/krkn-operator-acm-issues.jsonl after each commit. This ensures the local export stays in sync with the centralized database.

title: Add ownerReference to secrets created for KrknTargetRequest
description: When a secret is created for a KrknTargetRequest, add an ownerReference pointing to the KrknTargetRequest CR. This ensures automatic cleanup when the CR is deleted.
